intents.name: make_request
intents.description: Politely ask someone to do something

intents.name: express_interest
intents.description: Say what you are interested in

intents.name: suggest
intents.description: Propose a time, place or activity

situations.name: Small talk with a new colleague
situations.description: Break the ice with someone at work without freezing: ask about their weekend, share what you have been up to, and close warmly.
situations.goal: Have a relaxed two-minute chat and leave a friendly impression

prompts.question: What could you ask your colleague about?
What have you been up to lately?
prompts.hint: learning to cook, going to the gym

prompts.question: A place near work you could mention

situations.name: Ordering at a restaurant
situations.description: Get a table, ask what is good, order, mention an allergy and ask for the bill.
situations.goal: Order a meal confidently and handle the small questions that come with it

prompts.question: What do you want to order?
prompts.hint: the grilled salmon, a bowl of pho

situations.name: Asking for directions
situations.description: Stop a stranger, ask the way, understand the answer and check how far it is.
situations.goal: Find out how to reach a place and how long it takes

prompts.question: Where do you need to go?
prompts.hint: the train station, the airport, my hotel

situations.name: Checking into a hotel
situations.description: Give your booking, ask for the room you want, and find out what is included.
situations.goal: Check in smoothly and get your questions answered

prompts.question: Any room preference?
prompts.hint: with a view, on a higher floor

prompts.question: Where will you go when you leave?

situations.name: Meeting a professor
situations.description: Introduce yourself to a professor, say what you are interested in, and ask about research directions in the lab.
situations.goal: Introduce yourself and ask about research directions

prompts.question: What do you want to know more about?
What would you like to ask for?

situations.name: Job interview
situations.description: Present your experience and strengths, explain why you want the role, and ask good questions back.
situations.goal: Present yourself clearly and leave with your questions answered

prompts.question: What do you want from the next role?
What do you want to ask about?

situations.name: Calling a customer
situations.description: Open a work call, check it is a good time, handle a complaint calmly and promise a follow-up.
situations.goal: Sort out the issue and agree on the next step

prompts.question: What do you want to do on this call?

situations.name: At the doctor's
situations.description: Describe what is wrong, say when it hurts, mention allergies and understand the treatment.
situations.goal: Explain your symptoms and leave knowing what to do

situations.name: Making plans with friends
situations.description: Suggest meeting up, agree on a time and place, and cancel gracefully when you have to.
situations.goal: Fix a time and place to meet without a long back-and-forth

prompts.question: What do you want to do together?

dialogues.title: First chat in the break room

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: Hi! I'm new on the team, by the way.

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: Oh, welcome! I'm Sam. How's it going so far?

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: Pretty good, thanks. How was your {event}?

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: It was great, actually — very relaxing. And you?

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: I've been {activity} lately. It's been busy!

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: Nice. Have you had a chance to look around the area?

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: Not yet. Have you been to {place}?

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: Yes, it's great — we should go together sometime.

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: I'd love that. Do you have any plans for {time}?

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: Not really. Let's figure something out.

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: Sounds good. It was nice {closing}.

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: Good evening! Welcome. Do you have a reservation?

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: No, we don't. Could I get a table for {number}, please?

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: Of course, right this way. Here are the menus.

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: Thank you. What would you recommend?

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: The grilled salmon is very popular tonight.

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: Sounds good. Does this come with {side}?

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: Yes, it does. Anything to drink?

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: Just water for me. I'd like {dish}, please.

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: Certainly. Any allergies I should know about?

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: Yes — I'm allergic to {allergen}.

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: Noted, I'll let the kitchen know.

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: Thanks. When we're done, could we have the {item}, please?

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: Excuse me, how do I get to {place}?

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: Sure. Go straight for two blocks, then turn left at the bank.

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: Could you show me on the map?

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: Of course. We're here, and it's over there.

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: Is {place} far from here?

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: About fifteen minutes on foot. Or you can take the bus.

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: Which {transport} should I take?

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: Number 12. The stop is just across the street.

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: Great. How long does it take to get to {place}?

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: Ten minutes, maybe less.

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: Thanks so much for your help!

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: You're welcome. Have a good trip!

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: Good afternoon, welcome to the Riverside Hotel.

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: Hello. I have a reservation under the name {name}.

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: Let me check… yes, three nights in a double room.

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: Great. Could I have a room {feature}?

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: Let me see what's available… yes, room 812 is free.

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: Perfect. What time is {service}?

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: From 6:30 to 10, in the restaurant downstairs.

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: Is {amenity} included?

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: Yes, it's included in your rate.

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: One more thing — on Friday, could you call me a taxi to {destination}?

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: Of course. Just let us know the time. Enjoy your stay!

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: Good morning, Professor. Thank you for seeing me. I'm particularly interested in {interest}.

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: Nice to meet you. That's one of our main directions. What draws you to it?

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: I have some experience with {skill}. I'd like to go deeper.

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: That's a good foundation. We're currently working on two related projects.

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: Could you tell me more about {topic}?

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: Sure. The first one is more theoretical, the second is quite applied.

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: That sounds fascinating. Would it be possible to {request}?

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: Of course. We meet on Thursdays — I'll add you to the list.

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: Thank you for taking the time to {action}.

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: My pleasure. See you on Thursday.

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: Thanks for coming in. Could you start by telling me a bit about yourself?

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: Of course. I have {years} years of experience in {field}.

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: Great. What would you say you're good at?

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: One of my strengths is {strength}.

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: Can you give me an example from your last job?

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: Sure. In my previous role, I was responsible for {responsibility}.

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: And why are you interested in this position?

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: I'm looking for a role where I can {goal}.

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: That fits well. Do you have any questions for us?

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: Yes. Could you tell me more about {topic}?

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: Certainly. It's a team of six, and the next step would be a technical interview.

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: Thank you for taking the time to {action}.

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: Hello, this is Maria.

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: Hi Maria, this is Khoi from OpenTech. I'm calling about {matter}.

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: Oh, right. I was expecting your call.

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: Is now a good time to {purpose}?

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: Yes, go ahead. I did have a problem with the last delivery.

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: I'm sorry for the inconvenience. Let me check that for you.

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: Thanks. The tracking number is 4471.

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: Could you confirm {detail}?

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: Sure, it's maria@example.com.

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: Perfect. I'll send you the details by {deadline}.

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: Great, thank you for following up.

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: Hello, come in. What brings you here today?

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: I've had {symptom} for a few days.

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: I see. Any other symptoms?

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: It hurts when I {movement}.

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: Let me take a look… Are you allergic to any medication?

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: Yes, I'm allergic to {allergen}.

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: Okay, I'll note that. It looks like a mild infection.

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: Do I need {treatment}?

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: Yes, I'll write you a prescription for antibiotics.

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: How often should I take {medicine}?

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: One tablet twice a day, after meals. Come back if it gets worse.

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: Thank you, doctor.

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: Hey! Do you want to grab {meal} this weekend?

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: Yes! I've been meaning to catch up. When works for you?

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: How about {suggestion}?

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: Ah, I have a family thing then. Any other time?

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: I'm free {availability}.

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: Perfect, that works. Where?

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: Let's meet at {place}.

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: Great, see you there!

lines.speaker: self
lines.text: Also — sorry, I can't make it {when}. Rain check on that one?

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: No worries, another time!
